text:
nina_fin: quick question from ResaleWorksthey say our April marketplace payout is short by one line item: 3 reserved-instance credits not applied. Can we confirm?

omar_billing: which partner invoice? ResaleWorks typically includes a commit-credit column.

nina_fin: invoice RW-APR-2026-88. They pasted this snippet in the portal:
```
sku,usage_date,units,commit_credit
redwood-inference.reserved,2026-04-15,3,3
```

sarah_partners: tagging - we received a vendor note saying they expected the platform to auto-apply reservation credits to reduce their payable.

infra-bot: notice: billing-import v3.0.0 deployed 2026-04-14T22:40:12Z by deploy-bot.

omar_billing: pulling the marketplace reconciliation file now and our import CSV.

sarah_partners: ResaleWorks also flagged a timing mismatch - they submitted the credit after the close window, expecting us to pick it up in the next cycle. They included a "submit_timestamp": 2026-04-15T23:58:00Z in the portal upload.

nina_fin: policy note: we only accept commit credits with submit_timestamp <= close_time (Apr 15 23:59 UTC). That looks inside the window.

omar_billing: weird. our ledger import shows effective_units=0 adjustment for that sku on Apr 15. The raw marketplace report has commit_credit=3. The import log shows "skipped: unknown_credit_tag" for that row.

sarah_partners: unknown_credit_tag? That is new. We usually map their "commit_credit" to our field "reseller_commit_adj".

omar_billing: checking ingestion schema change: build notes from v3.0.0 mention stricter enum validation for credit_type; unknown enums get dropped. Looks like ResaleWorks used credit_type "reservation-credit" while our enum is "reservation_credit" with underscore. The validation flagged it and we skipped the row.

nina_fin: so it's a mapping/normalization mismatch introduced by the strict enum enforcement. What's the impact $ amount?

omar_billing: unit credit value for reserved = $1200 per unit in April. 3 * 1200 = $3,600. Need a partner credit application so their payable is lowered by $3,600.

terry_treasury: pre-approve credit for $3,600 if ledger backfill confirms the missing rows. Send PO/notes to treasury mailbox for processing.

sarah_partners: I'll notify ResaleWorks and confirm they used "reservation-credit" literal in their CSV. Ask them to reupload with underscore? Or we can implement a tolerant mapping.

nina_fin: prefer we avoid asking partners to change format. Ops can add a mapping fallback to normalize hyphen/underscore variants. Also need to patch the validation so unknown enums fall back instead of skipping rows.

omar_billing: agreed. Proposed remediation: (1) create one-time ledger credit of $3,600 and mark as "partner reconciliation adjustment", (2) re-run the ingestion for Apr 15 with tolerant mapping, (3) add unit test and deploy a v3.0.1 that includes underscore/hyphen normalization and default mapping for credit_type.

infra-bot: rollout plan required for v3.0.1. create a release PR and link to deploy playbook.

terry_treasury: confirmed pre-approval. Proceed with the credit once import is re-run and ledger file generated. I'll hold payment until FIN ticket created.

sarah_partners: created a partner ticket and messaged them: "We found a schema mismatch on credit_type; we'll apply a $3,600 adjustment and patch ingest to accept both variants. No action required on your side."

omar_billing: re-run complete. ledger import file s3://redwood-billing/reconciliations/2026-04-15-resaleworks-backfill.csv. Import id: imp-2026-04-16-7721.

nina_fin: credit note PDF drafted, attached to FIN-3490. awaiting treasury payment scheduling.

terry_treasury: scheduling payment in next AP run. marking FIN-3490 as approved for payment.

sarah_partners: closing loop with ResaleWorks: they confirmed their accounting matches after our credit. thanks everyone.

omar_billing: follow-ups: (a) add normalization to ingestion v3.0.1, (b) add monitoring alert for enum validation drop count >0, (c) include example partner CSV edge cases in integration test suite.

nina_fin: noted. RCA summary in FIN-3490: ingestion v3.0.0 enforced strict enum validation and rejected hyphenated credit_type from partner, dropping their commit credit row. Remediation: issued $3,600 credit, re-imported ledger, added normalization and test coverage, deployed v3.0.1 with guardrails.

terry_treasury: fine. close the FIN ticket after payment posts.

nina_fin: leaving thread open until payment posts.
